nc.description: A grey, cylindrical object with an encircling ring and a glowing circular detail floats against a white background with its top cap detached and hovering above it.
A 3D-rendered mechanical device with two coiled springs and a jointed end extends toward a detached cylinder and two small cubes.
A light grey, faceted mechanical appendage with a circular base and a hinged, blocky component is displayed against a plain white background.
A grey object with wavy cables extending from one side and straight rods from the other has a cracked white rectangular block attached to its side.
A collection of light grey, faceted 3D objects, including rock-like shapes and various geometric components, is arranged on a plain white surface.

vc.description: A grey cylindrical object with a latching mechanism is shown with its threaded cap detached.
A grey mechanical device consists of braided cables entering a central articulated block that extends into several rods ending in two threaded nozzles.
A close-up shows a light grey plastic suction cup mount with a lever mechanism positioned over a textured pad on its circular base.
A light-grey mechanical assembly featuring articulated arms, a molded handle, a shattered glass pane, radial fins, and a disc brake caliper is displayed against a white background.
A disassembled grey tool handle and its scattered components are arranged in the center, surrounded by metal channels above and corrugated panels below.
